reviewed_by: Codex; independent fresh-context TUI root-cause validation before repair
reason: Typing slash in the Python terminal client now renders and filters a selectable command menu using selected chat, turn, and attention state. Three focused client tests cover command availability and PTY keyboard interaction; one paired TLS LAN Core test covers the real shell entry, command dispatch, saved chat, and reconnect. Two product-help tests cover the updated guidance and bundled source digest.
exclusions: No browser UI, frontend, or native code changed, so frontend, Playwright, and Rust tests do not apply. The paired LAN test uses a synthetic project and inert provider; it does not access a live Core. A separate client wheel build verifies packaging.
